source: tools/oracle/oracle_gen.py --target win-365-ja_JP (full corpus, WSL2 -> Windows COM bridge)
reason: Formula-track goldens under golden/ were re-captured on a product-verified Microsoft 365 ja-JP host; oracle_gen.py runs OracleDriver.assert_m365_or_abort() before the first suite, so the ARRAYTOTEXT(1) sentinel gated this capture. `product` mirrors the `environment.excel_version` the goldens carry (Application.Version reports the bare "16.0" on Windows); `product_build` is EXCEL.EXE's file version, read separately, and is the real build evidence. This replaces the Office Professional Plus 2019 Retail capture that previously occupied this directory -- that data is retained unchanged under tests/oracle/reference/win-2019-ja_JP/. `active_ctest` stays false: provenance.py's variant inventory check requires every golden's environment block to carry a per-capture `capture_id`, and the formula-track generator does not stamp one (unlike the workbook track's PROVENANCE.candidate.json flow). Landing this as active variant coverage needs that stamp plus a suite inventory.
